response.evidence: In the 'On your own server' section, under 'Start your application with the following command:', the artifact presents two tabs labeled 'Static' and 'On demand'. The Static tab shows the command 'deno run -A jsr:@std/http/file-server dist' and the On demand tab shows 'deno run -A ./dist/server/entry.mjs'. The page also states: 'Your Astro project can be deployed as a static site, or as an on-demand rendered site.'
response.rationale: The two commands are presented as mutually exclusive tab options keyed to the deployment type: the file-server command serves the static 'dist' output, while the entry.mjs command runs the server build for on-demand rendering. They are alternatives chosen based on whether the site is static or on-demand rendered, not commands to run together or in different environments.
